snippet.title: Squarelings Steam Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam Link: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4887300/Squarelings/

Welcome to Squarelings

Squarelings is a 4–12 player co-op puzzle platformer built around teamwork, communication and chaos.

Grab your friends and work together through a variety of levels designed to constantly change how you play the game.

One level might be all about careful platforming and perfect timing. The next might have you blasting lasers from your spaceship, stacking as food ingredients or making a painting together.

We want every level to feel different, but one rule always remains:

If one player fails, everybody fails.

You’ll need to communicate, plan ahead, improvise when that plan immediately falls apart and occasionally decide which friend deserves the blame. It's probably Orange.. again.

The controls are simple. The teamwork is not.

Play Together, However You Like
Squarelings supports Online Co-op, Local Co-op, or a combination of both, with local players able to join together in an online lobby.

There is no automatic matchmaking, so Squarelings is best played with a group of friends.

Need a few more Squarelings to complete your team? Join our Discord community to find other players, organize games, and meet fellow Squarelings.
